boundary: This evidence-bound screen is not a recommendation, return forecast, account-suitability conclusion, portfolio allocation or order instruction.

decision.reason: Do not select an ETF, option contract, strike, expiry, size, broker, calendar or threshold. C51 does not admit a stable-five-percent strategy or any personal execution path.

payoff_boundary.collar_terminal_value: min(S_T, K_C) + max(K_P - S_T, 0) + C - P
payoff_boundary.formula_provenance: Generic derivative payoff algebra only; it is not an SSE rule, market-data-interface or exchange formula.
payoff_boundary.interpretation: For normalized same-expiry legs, the general collar formula creates a bounded terminal payoff but does not impose a positive five-percent return floor. The compact max(K_P, min(S_T, K_C)) expression is equivalent only when K_P <= K_C; C51 selects no strikes and therefore uses the general formula. Without a pre-frozen K_P, K_C, C, P and S_0 relationship, no 5% conclusion can be made; even a selected formula would require complete execution and cost accounting.

relationship_to_c48.effect: C51 maps a distinct payoff family but does not close C48's point-in-time, total-return/event, availability/version, execution or rights gates.

required_but_missing_before_any_formal_t: 逐日点时点完整的实际 ETF 期权合约主表，包括上市、摘牌、行权价、合约单位、除权调整、停复牌、到期和行权/交收状态。
每个冻结决策时点的逐合约双边报价、五档深度、成交、拒单、部分成交、未成交和官方结算记录。
标的 ETF 的总回报、分配、公司行动、交易状态及与期权调整的可审计映射。
带日期的交易所费率、券商佣金、保证金或备兑锁定、行权与交收成本及账户流程证据。
在查看结果前冻结的标的、到期、行权价、保护腿、换月、无成交和成本规则，以及独立重建全部年度和滚动五年端点。
匿名但可审计的账户权限、券商路由、备兑锁定、组合处理和结算可行性证据；公开规则不能替代这些记录。
若未来主张正式组合策略或同步组合委托，还需保留对应的交易所实施通知、实际可用性和券商工作流证据；本工件不作此主张。

rule_evidence.sse_market_data_interface: The retained SSE interface specification presents option reference, real-time, closing-price and combination-strategy data-file categories. A technical specification neither establishes that a collar is a currently enabled formal combination strategy nor provides a rights-cleared point-in-time historical option chain, bid/ask/depth tape, order/fill record or replay right.
rule_evidence.sse_suitability: The current SSE guideline contains individual-investor conditions and first-level permission categories for covered opening with the underlying held and for corresponding put-buying opening with the underlying held. This is a category-level rule fact only, not an account entitlement.
rule_evidence.sse_trading: The current SSE trading rule contains covered-security lock and order-validity mechanics, and the retained text contains corporate-action adjustment terminology. This does not establish a selected contract, fill, cost, exercise or settlement outcome.

scope: A rule-level, no-selection screen of whether an SSE ETF collar is economically distinct from the previously reviewed covered-call route. It is not a product choice, option-series selection, historical test, account decision or action instruction.

strict_hurdle_screen.hurdle: Long-run annualized return above 5% as a research objective only, not a promise or guarantee.
strict_hurdle_screen.reason: The rule evidence allows a bounded collar definition but supplies neither a five-percent floor nor the complete, rights-cleared historical and execution inputs required to test net outcomes.

cffex_index_option_overlay.boundary: A possible index-option overlay is not treated as an ETF covered position and is not developed here. It would require separately retained rule evidence and a complete point-in-time contract, quote, execution and account data package before any new protocol could be registered.

existing_covered_call_C13.no_reopen_rule: Do not rename, retune or substitute the covered-call structure into a new candidate.
existing_covered_call_C13.relationship: The prior 510300 plus covered call family is the same economic structure. Changing ETF, strike, expiry or venue does not create a new route.

short_option_premium.reason: Premium income is compensation for nonlinear downside and assignment risk rather than a contractual positive return floor. No naked or cash-secured short-option structure is selected, tested or made actionable.

sse_etf_collar.distinctness: A collar changes the payoff by paying for downside protection; it is economically distinct from a covered call, but it still depends on the same option-chain, eligibility, quotation, adjustment, settlement and execution infrastructure.
sse_etf_collar.economic_structure: Long a single ETF, sell a covered call and buy a put on the same normalized option exposure and expiry. No ETF, option contract, strike, expiry, size, weight or roll calendar is selected here.
sse_etf_collar.rule_level_feasibility: The retained SSE suitability guideline contains covered-opening and corresponding put-buying permission categories, while the trading rule contains covered-security locking and order-validity mechanics. Neither establishes any particular person's eligibility, broker workflow, collar-combination availability or simultaneous-combination execution path.
